sloka: तं निर्विषाशीविषसन्निकाशं शान्तार्चिषं सूर्यमिवाप्रकाशम् ।गतश्रियं कृत्तकिरीटकूटमुवाच रामो युधि राक्षसेन्द्रम् ।। ६.५९.१४२ ।।।।
transliteration: taṁ nirviṣāśīviṣasannikāśaṁ śāntārciṣaṁ sūryamivāprakāśam ।gataśriyaṁ kṛttakirīṭakūṭamuvāca rāmo yudhi rākṣasendram ।। 6.59.142 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama said to the king of Rakshasas, who was like a serpent rid of poison without (head) crown, without splendour like the Sun without brightness, his glory lost with the crown broken in the combat.
